ratings.reviewer_notes: Directly shows that icariin promotes osteogenic differentiation of BMSCs by upregulating miR-335-5p, which inhibits PTEN; inhibitor, mimic, and PTEN rescue experiments support the pathway.
Directly investigates icariin-induced osteoblast differentiation in MC3T3-E1 cells and identifies a miR-153/Runx2 mechanism using expression, reporter, inhibitor, and differentiation assays.
Direct mechanistic evidence that icariin promotes MC3T3-E1 osteogenic differentiation through the circ_0000349/miR-138-5p/JMJD3 axis, increasing ALP, RUNX2, and mineralization.
Shows an indirect intercellular miRNA mechanism: icariin enriches miR-331-3p in osteoclast-derived exosomes, which promotes osteoblast function through the FGF23/DKK1/ALP pathway.
Demonstrates icariin-induced osteogenic differentiation through PI3K-AKT-eNOS-NO-cGMP-PKG signaling, but does not examine a miRNA mechanism.
Provides relevant evidence that miR-21 promotes BMSC osteogenic differentiation by repressing PTEN, but icariin is not studied.
Directly links icariin to miR-376c-3p/Mmp3 regulation, but the tested outcome is inhibition of osteoclastogenesis rather than osteoblast differentiation.

Directly shows that icariin upregulates miR-21-5p and counters titanium particle-induced inhibition of MC3T3-E1 osteoblast differentiation and mineralization; miR-21-5p knockdown abolishes the benefit.
Shows that icariin promotes osteoblastogenesis through IGF-I/ERα/Akt signaling, but does not provide a miRNA-related mechanism.
Icariin regulates miR-335 in steroid-injured bone microvascular endothelial cells and prevents osteonecrosis, but osteoblast differentiation is not examined.
Directly demonstrates that icariin promotes hBMSC osteogenesis by downregulating miR-23a and activating Wnt/β-catenin signaling, supported by miRNA mimic and inhibitor experiments.

Directly reports that icariin restores LPS-impaired osteogenic differentiation and mineralization by downregulating miR-34c, restoring Runx2 and other osteogenic markers, and suppressing inflammatory signaling.
Examines mechanical-strain regulation of osteoclast differentiation through miR-21/PTEN/PI3K/Akt; neither icariin nor osteoblast differentiation is studied.
